notable_quotes: Compared with CO2, C2 hydrocarbons have slightly larger size and stronger binding affinity, leading to higher desorption resistance in Zn2(Atz)2Ox.
The C2 hydrocarbon hysteresis in Zn2(Atz)2Ox is classified as a type H1 loop, consistent with adsorption in cylindrical-shape channels.
The paper attributes adsorption hysteresis mainly to capillary condensation, governed by adsorbate properties and pore size/shape characteristics.
